title: fix(metadata-protocol): an unshipped email-template locale keeps its write before the pair is ensured; the named-base refusal names os migrate packageless-overlays
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgBNPpAVVeFjdqPfxDbdEPKj)_

domain:server#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYVV6fcAQrNTDQRvPb

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 给系统自带的邮件模板加一个基础包没有的语种（比如 showcase 只带英文，管理员加中文），在新装环境里现在能直接保存；指名基础包的写入（`?package=BASE`）同理。基础包已有的语种照旧被拒，并指向 `.custom` 配对包。
- **为什么改：** 代码注释写明这种写入应保持开放，但新环境里配对包还没建出来，判断「能否写进配对包」时拿到「不归我管」，被当成「能」，于是先拒一次；照报错去配对包写，又因基础包没有这个语种被拒第二次，翻译加不进去。拒绝句另补上 `os migrate packageless-overlays`，告诉运维这条命令能把老的基础包绑定行挪进配对包（#29479）。
- **风险与回滚：** 不加参数、不改错误码和状态；只改配对包尚未安装时的判断依据（按 ensure 门将要给它的依赖闭包）。指名基础包的拒绝句措辞变了（为塞进 500 字上限而收短），dogfood 钉住的 rollback 片段原样保留。回滚即撤 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts`（`overlayPairFixOf` 新增的 `pendingPairScope`、`overlayPairFixAdmits` 的调用、`closedOverlayWriteClauses` 的 `boundRowServed`），`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.named-base-overlay-write.test.ts`（新 describe「a fresh install, the pair not yet ensured」）。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.named-base-overlay-write.test.ts -t "fresh install"`：三条全绿，两条无包和指名基础包的 fr-FR 写入成功，en-US 对照仍是 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

Fixes #30168
Fixes #29479

Clause-②: no — the fix restores the write `packagelessCloseSubject`'s docblock documents as open ("An `email_template` member at a locale the base does not ship is refused there (#28777) and stays open"); a pair that is installed was already answered that way, and nothing outside that documented set is admitted.
Metadata-protocol: semantic — an author's package-less (or named-base) save of an unshipped email-template locale, refused `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` on an install whose pair was not yet ensured, now succeeds.
Skills-docs: none — `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` line 128 (PR #29924) already states the package-less write of an unshipped locale is kept ("an email-template row at a locale the base does not ship moves as the pair's own member and keeps that write"); this PR makes the runtime match it.

## What changes

**#30168 — the close read "no such package" as "admitted".** Both overlay-write closes (`packagelessCloseSubject`, and `namedBaseCloseSubject` for `?package=BASE`) close a write only where the fix they name can be taken, and ask the override write gate about the declared body written into the pair (`overlayPairFixAdmits`). The gate reads the written package's closure from the registry (`resolveWritePackageScope`). On a fresh install the pair `BASE.custom` is not installed yet, so that read answers `undefined` and `overrideWriteVerdict` answers `not_concerned`, which `overlayPairFixAdmits` treats as "not refused". The close then closed a write whose fix is refused once the pair exists (`declared_package_ships_no_such_item`): the card's double refusal. Every existing pin booted with the pair installed, so none saw it.

- `overlayPairFixOf` now carries `pendingPairScope` when the pair is not installed: the closure the ensure door gives it (one dependency, the base, `manifest.dependencies: { [base]: range }`), so the base plus what the base reaches, read with `resolvePackageClosure`, the gate's own walk.
- `overrideWriteVerdict` (module function and the class method) takes an optional `writtenScope` used in place of the registry read for that package. Only `overlayPairFixAdmits` passes one; every door's own write passes none, so no door's verdict moves.
- `OverrideWriteVerdictAsk` types the gate as both closes' hosts ask it (`NamedBaseCloseHost`, `PackagelessCloseHost`).

**The first act's measurement (step 1 both ways).** On a fresh showcase boot (`pnpm dev -- --fresh`, this branch), `PUT /api/v1/meta/email_template/showcase_task_done_email`:

- with `?member=zh-CN`: `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` "The "member" query parameter is not supported by this endpoint … Supported parameters: force, mode, package, surface." The save door is body-addressed (`META_ITEM_SAVE_PARAMS`), so this spelling never reaches the close.
- without it, with `locale: 'zh-CN'` in the body: the close reads the body's member (`overlayMemberOfBody` → `zh-CN`), the right one. The defect was the gate half above, not the member reading; the docblock is right and the code was wrong.

**#29479 — the named-base sentence names the ceremony.** Since PR #29477, `os migrate packageless-overlays` moves a row stored bound to the read-only base into the pair with its declaration; the refusal did not say so. `closedOverlayWriteClauses` gains two clauses, one spelling each: `ceremony` (the command, now used by both sentences, byte-identical in the package-less one) and `boundRowServed`, used by the named-base save, publish and rollback sentences: "… is served until moved by `os migrate packageless-overlays`, overridden by the pair, or deleted naming the base." The previous tail ("served until the pair declares the override, or a delete naming the base removes it") was shortened to fit: with the ceremony added in the long form, the file's 30-character-base / 40-character-name pin measured 525 (save) and 511 (rollback) characters against the REST door's 500 (`CLIENT_MESSAGE_MAX`). The phrase the dogfood suite pins ("a rollback of its row bound to the read-only base is closed") is unchanged. Docblocks that said the ceremony never moves a base-bound row (`NamedBaseWriteOperation`, `namedBaseOverlayWriteRefusal` in both files) are corrected.

## Tests

`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.named-base-overlay-write.test.ts`: `makeProtocol({ pairInstalled: false })` boots the base with no pair, and a new top-level describe pins:

- the package-less save of `crm_welcome` at `fr-FR` (the base ships the canonical member only) is accepted and stored package-less;
- the save naming the base at `fr-FR` is accepted, as it is with the pair installed;
- CONTROL: the canonical member is still closed onto the pair at both addresses, with the pair not yet ensured, and nothing is written.

`expectClosedSentence` now also asserts the `boundRowServed` clause on every named-base sentence; the 500-character pin covers the new length.

<details><summary>Red first, on origin/main 04f36b63</summary>

```

× the save naming the base is accepted, as it is with the pair installed
Error: 'email_template/crm_welcome' ships in 'com.acme.crm': save it into 'com.acme.crm.custom' (?package=com.acme.crm.custom), declaring overrides: { package: 'com.acme.crm', basedOn }. A write naming no package is closed where `os migrate packageless-overlays` can move its row (ADR-0146 D11); …
Tests  2 failed | 32 passed (34)
```
The CONTROL case was green on main too.
</details>

The suite imports the source (`./protocol.js`), so no `dist/` leg applies.

## Signature notes (for the next PR on these functions)

`classifyPackagelessRow` is unchanged. `overlayPairFixAdmits` keeps its parameters and result; its host's `overrideWriteVerdict` is typed `OverrideWriteVerdictAsk` (one optional parameter, `writtenScope`), and it passes `fix.pendingPairScope`. `OverlayPairFix` gains the optional `pendingPairScope`, present only while the pair is not installed.

## Acceptance notes

- Live readings (fresh showcase boot, this branch): package-less zh-CN save `200`, served at `?member=zh-CN` as the environment's own member while en-US stays the package's; `?package=com.example.showcase` fr-FR save `200`; both en-US controls `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` naming the pair, the named-base one with the new clause.
- `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx`'s D11 callout says a package-less write onto an item one read-only package ships is refused, without the unshipped-locale exception. This PR does not make it false (the exception was documented in code and skills, not there); left as is.

## Verification
